messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Soft-lock applied to runtime v3.2.1 for quantized model family (llm-q*). Auto-unpin disabled. Trigger: p99 generation latency spike in prod us-west-2. Details: https://ops/metrics/1766012345 :rotating_light:
alice: saw the spike on the dashboard around 10:34 UTC, thanks for locking. can you share quick impact estimate?
ben: what's the rollback surface? can we just revert runtime to v3.2.0 on affected pools? :thinking:
carla: rollback is safest but has config churn. alternative: route quantized models to non-quant variant for a week. that keeps runtime but avoids kernel path.
dmitri: logs from agent on host-07: ```ERROR kernel_select: fallback to fp16 kernel; latency p99=325ms
2026-03-20T10:34:52Z host-07 qload failed: mmap EFAULT
``` looks like kernel selector encountering mmap failures under quant load.
jess: QA canary saw a 4-6% p50 shift and ~18% p99 at 03:00 UTC for longseq tests after v3.2.1. I re-ran with batch_size=4 and it still reproduced.
ben: if we rollback, prefer small window 01:00-02:00 UTC to minimize customer sessions. otherwise staged by region.
alice: tagging @oncall-eng-runtime to own ops. please call it out in the runbook.
oncall-eng-runtime: I will own rollback. Proposed plan: 1) revert runtime on dedicated-us-west-2 canary (10% traffic) to v3.2.0, 2) monitor p99 & error-rate for 30m, 3) if stable, roll to remaining dedicated pools, 4) then consider unpin + patch. ETA: start in ~90m.
carla: add a contingency: if rollback fails, switch routing to hosted non-quant variant + disable KV-cache for quant models + cap batch_size to 8. This reduces perf footprint.
deploy-bot: scheduled action created: `/deploy revert runtime v3.2.1 -> v3.2.0 --scope=dedicated-us-west-2 --when=2026-03-20T01:00:00Z` action id `db-8421`. Will post progress updates here. :white_check_mark:
alice: approved. please also add a release note stub: "Temporary revert of runtime v3.2.1 due to latency regressions impacting quantized models; investigating kernel selection and mmap handling."
ben: engineering task: reproduce locally with perf-harness against quantized q4_* models, test kernel flags `--force-kernel=autodetect` vs `--force-kernel=fp16`, and validate mmap resiliency.
dmitri: kicking off profiling job `prof-778` to capture kernel selection traces and allocator dumps. forwarding artifacts to #eng-runtime-artifacts.
deploy-bot: update: rollback queued as `db-8421`. Will emit start/complete messages and timeline. If anyone objects to the rollback plan, flag now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
